config.more_cobblemon_contents_league_ch: Server rules: edit the active League data pack under league-challenge/.
Level caps: match each League cap to a numeric tier in Cobbled Level Control. Client settings cannot override server caps.
Wild levels: edit wild_level in the data pack's leagues/active.json. Regions default to levels 10-83 and 64x64 blocks; Pokemon spawn 3-9 levels below the lower of the regional level and your cap.
Teams, trainers, rewards and appearances are replaceable data-pack definitions. Skins use local resource-pack textures.
Apply data packs with /reload (operator permission required). Invalid catalogs keep the last valid version; active runs keep their original teams.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.more_cobb: Progress through gyms, badges, ranks, the Elite Four and Champion battles. This MCC addon uses a dedicated terminal and GUI, with league rules defined by server data packs and level-cap integration.
